plan.title: Render the common status report as Markdown without changing verdicts

criteria.description: Markdown status preserves missing, pass and stale exit decisions and reports NOT VERIFIED; conflicting output flags are rejected.
Markdown rendering escapes untrusted table content, retains relay provenance and propagates output failures.

limitations: NARU-018 report presentation slice; baseline and policy aggregation and the final adapter matrix remain pending.
No push, deployment, installation or settings changes.
